statutory.question: Does the conduct described fall within 5324?
statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: Under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3), it is unlawful to structure or attempt to structure transactions in currency to evade reporting requirements. The facts show six separate transactions, including cash and wire transfers, that collectively approach the declared monthly volume and involve amounts under $100,000. Each transaction is below the $10,000 reporting threshold when considered individually, and the pattern of multiple cash transactions on different dates demonstrates an effort to keep each below the reporting trigger. This conduct satisfies the statutory elements of (i) conducting multiple transactions, (ii) in currency, and (iii) with the purpose of evading reporting. Therefore the behavior falls within the prohibitions of § 5324(a)(3). yes it does
